note_text:
R wrist injury yesterday AM. Slipped on stairs carrying laundry, landed on outstretched arms. Pain 9/10, swelling. Hx of prior wrist fracture. Denies numbness/tingling. Ice, ACE wrap and ibuprofen with some relief. Non-smoker.
Exam: L wrist tender on palpation, pain on flexion/extension, swelling and bruising, bony crepitus. Metacarpals intact.
X-ray: Colles fracture, extra-articular, dorsal angulation, ulnar styloid fracture.
Plan: ORIF asap, overnight stay. Brace 6 weeks. Ultram 100 mg q6h for pain. PT 3x/week after surgery. Follow-up in 1 month.
